item_short_desc: Keep your rifles clean with Rothco's AK-47 Rifle Cleaning Kit. This kit comes in an olive drab pouch with ALICE clips and includes a six piece rod with handle, an 18.5 cm slotted adapter, an oil bottle, a 7.62 x 82 mm brass bore brush, a 7.62 x 96 mm brass chamber brush, a dual end pp cleaning brush, and 25 non-woven patches.
